variants.name: Area
variants.description: The number and the chart stop sharing a row: the tile becomes one column, so the sparkline drops under the figure and runs the full width as a filled area with a caption.
variants.guidance: Use when the shape of the month matters as much as the number, and when the tile has the width to spend: a full width area reads a trend a 8.5rem sparkline cannot. The fill is a linearGradient whose stops are currentColor with alpha only, and data-ai-tone on the svg sets the colour the whole drawing inherits, so the line and the fade are one hue by construction and an accent swap recolours both. The gradient id must be unique in the document, which is why it is named for this variant. The line carries vector-effect non-scaling-stroke so stretching the viewBox to the tile width never thickens it. The chart is aria-hidden and the caption under it carries the period and the total in text, because an area with no axis is a shape and not a reading. Do not stamp four of these across a dashboard: one dominant number per tile is law 8, and four area charts in a row is the generated-template tell. Do not add a second series to the fill, because two overlapping alpha ramps mix into a third colour that keys nothing.
